description: Identify auspicious & powerful classical Vedic Yogas present in a birth or mundane chart (e.g. Raja Yogas, Dhana Yogas, Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas, Gaja Kesari, Budhaditya). Corresponds to the /yogas slash command in Discord and Google Chat. Requires birth details ('date', 'time', 'city') or country name ('country'). Returns active yogas, classical definitions, and link to ERUX divisional varga breakdown.
